attchmntText: Global Vectra Helicorp Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Global Vectra Helicorp Limited submitted unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The Board of Directors approved the results on 13th November 2026. The company reported a net loss after taxes of 3,832.64 lakhs and a net loss after other comprehensive income of 4,285.40 lakhs. Net worth stood at negative 5,202.16 lakhs. Current liabilities exceeded current assets by 29,811.69 lakhs. The auditors highlighted a material uncertainty related to going concern due to these financial positions. An emphasis of matter notes a customs demand of 25,233.68 lakhs regarding IGST exemption on helicopter imports. The company contests this demand and has not made any provision. The limited review report issued by Kalyaniwalla & Mistry LLP states that nothing came to their attention indicating material misstatements in the financial results.

attchmntText: Global Vectra Helicorp Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
